jobs.jd: Role: Manage day-to-day accounting, maintain accurate financial records, coordinate payments and collections, and support financial reporting and statutory compliance across the companys business activities. Key Responsibilities Maintain books of accounts and record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, expenses, and journal entries. Prepare and verify customer invoices, vendor bills, debit notes, and credit notes with supporting documents. Manage accounts payable and receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments. Reconcile bank statements, customer and vendor ledgers, and intercompany balances, where applicable. Maintain petty cash records and verify employee expense claims and reimbursements. Check purchase orders, delivery challans, goods receipt records, and invoices before processing payments. Coordinate with procurement, stores, sales, and operations teams to reconcile inventory transactions and resolve billing discrepancies. Prepare payroll inputs and support salary processing, deductions, and reimbursement calculations. Compile records and coordinate with the Chartered Accountant or tax consultant for GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory filings. Assist with monthly and annual closing, financial statements, audit schedules, and supporting documentation. Prepare periodic reports on cash flow, expenses, collections, payables, receivables, and budget variances. Maintain fixed asset records and assist with depreciation schedules. Ensure proper filing, confidentiality, and easy retrieval of financial records. Highlight payment discrepancies, overdue balances, and unusual transactions to management.

jobs.jd: Junior Accountant & GST Executive Tally Prime The selected candidate will work on multiple client assignments under the guidance of senior team members and will be expected to maintain accuracy, confidentiality and timely completion of assigned tasks. Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting & Bookkeeping Maintain day-to-day accounting records in Tally Prime . Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journals and contra entries. Maintain cash books, bank books, ledgers and supporting vouchers. Perform bank reconciliation and party ledger reconciliation. Verify invoices, debit notes, credit notes and expense vouchers. Maintain accounts payable and receivable records. Assist in preparing trial balances, financial statements and year-end accounting schedules. Identify missing entries and accounting discrepancies and coordinate for corrections. 2. GST Compliance Prepare GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B return workings. Reconcile purchase invoices with GSTR-2B . Verify GST invoices, tax rates, input tax credit and sales/purchase records. Assist in GST registration, amendment and cancellation documentation. Maintain GST return workings, challans, acknowledgements and supporting records. Coordinate with clients to collect pending invoices and GST-related information. Assist senior staff with GST notices, reconciliations and annual compliance assignments. 3. Income Tax, TDS & Taxation Support Assist with collection and verification of documents required for income tax returns. Prepare basic income and expense summaries and supporting schedules. Assist senior staff in TDS-related reconciliations and documentation. Maintain PAN, tax payment, challan and acknowledgement records. Organize financial data and working papers for taxation assignments. 4. Business Registration & Compliance Documentatio
jobs.requirement_text:
Assist senior staff with GST notices, reconciliations and annual compliance assignments.
Income Tax, TDS & Taxation Support Assist with collection and verification of documents required for income tax returns.
Required Skills Essential: Hands-on experience with Tally Prime .
Preferred / Additional Advantage: Experience working in a CA firm, accounting firm or taxation consultancy.
GST registration and amendment experience.
PAN and Udyam registration experience.
Candidate Eligibility Qualification: B.Com, M.Com or equivalent commerce background preferred.
Experience: 13 years of relevant practical accounting and GST experience.
Must be willing to work full-time from our Anand Parbat, New Delhi office .
Relevant practical experience.

jobs.jd: About Us Technocraft Ventures Limited (Formerly known as Technocraft Construction Private Limited) is a 27-year-old infrastructure company specializing in sewerage networks, sewage treatment plants, and allied water infrastructure works across India. We execute projects under national flagship programmes including AMRUT 2.0, Namami Gange, and state-level urban development missions, with operations spanning 6+ states and an annual turnover exceeding 300 crore Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Taxation Accountant with 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in GST compliance, TDS return filing, accounting, ITC reconciliation and statutory reporting. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Tally, Computax, Microsoft Excel, the GST Portal and the TRACES Portal. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end GST and TDS compliance, maintaining accurate tax records, reconciling ITC, preparing statutory returns and coordinating with internal departments, senior officials and tax consultants to ensure timely and accurate compliance. Key responsibilities 1. GST Accounting & Compliance Record all GST-related transactions in Tally, including purchases, sales, subcontracting, expenses, capital goods, ISD, RCM and GST TDS. Maintain GST liability, electronic credit and cash ledger records. Maintain invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills and supporting documents. Prepare state-wise GST liability and payment statements, including ITC, cash payments and challans. Verify GST TDS entries uploaded by government departments and other deductors. 2. GST Return Filing Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and ISD returns, wherever applicable. Review and process entries appearing in GSTR-2B. Prepare and file GSTR-9 and GSTR-9C, wherever applicable. Ensure

You will process invoices accurately, ensure timely payments, and maintain strong controls across invoice validation, matching, and exception handling. You will identify recurring errors, process gaps, and aging issues, and escalate them to support continuous improvement. You will maintain accurate records and support month-end AP activities, including reporting and control checks. Catch extra work early: raise variations and amendments and get the order or written approval while the work is being done, not after. 6. Reconcile every month, project by project: ordered vs supplied vs billed vs paid. Flag proformas not converted to tax invoices, advances without invoices, credit notes not re-billed, and bills raised to the wrong entity or at the wrong rate. 7. Answer client and PMC que

This is a processing role with direct accountability for data integrity, deadlines, state-wise compliance templates and audit-ready records. Key Responsibilities: Benefits Administration: Enrollment and Eligibility Enrollment : Process new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, open enrollment elections and terminations across medical, dental, vision, life, disability and voluntary plans. Eligibility : Track eligibility and waiting periods, resolve eligibility disputes and enrollment discrepancies, and keep plan rules documented by state and employee class. COBRA : Initiate and track COBRA notices and continuation coverage on terminations and reductions in hours. Employee Support : Manage and triage the benefits inbox, answer employee and manager questions, and close out requests within agreed turnaround times Carrier, EDI and Vendor Management EDI Feeds: Monitor carrier EDI feeds (UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, The Hartford and others), work error and discrepancy reports, and confirm elections and terminations land correctly with each carrier. Invoice Reconciliation: Reconcile monthly carrier invoices against payroll deductions and enrollment records, flag variances, and raise credits and corrections with carriers and the broker. Vendor Tracker: Maintain the shared vendor request tracker (including WEX account items) with daily status updates, owners, dependencies and turnaround times for the client's accounting and HR tea

jobs.jd: About this role HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offer the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients. HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”). Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).
